title: Shell归档日志清理：NUL预览、身份复核和互斥执行
body:
## 操作任务
提交task.sh，执行 bash task.sh preview|apply 根目录 截止Unix秒 计划文件 互斥锁文件。根目录必须是非根目录的规范绝对路径且不是符号链接，计划及锁在根目录外。仅处理根目录第一层普通文件且名称以.log.gz结尾、修改时间严格早于截止秒；不得触碰活动日志、子目录或符号链接。preview生成NUL分隔计划，记录根目录、截止秒及每项路径和设备/ inode /修改秒/大小；apply获得相同非阻塞互斥锁并先完整复核所有条目，再删除清单内文件。身份改变或路径不符时在任何删除之前失败。锁已占用退出75；空目录安全。假设受控目录不存在恶意并发写入，此合同不证明检查与删除之间的对抗性竞态安全，也不配置真实cron。

## 提交产物
task.sh

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
实际Bash、find、stat和flock在普通student临时目录中操作；覆盖空格及换行文件名、截止秒边界、活动日志、嵌套目录、符号链接、锁竞争和inode替换。仅本题自有归档目录，不触碰宿主日志、不安排系统定时任务，且不宣称防御恶意并发写者。无镜像构建。
answer:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -o pipefail
if (( $# != 5 )); then exit 64; fi
mode=$1; root=$2; cutoff=$3; manifest=$4; lock=$5
[[ $mode == preview || $mode == apply ]] || exit 64
[[ $root == /* && -d $root && ! -L $root && $cutoff =~ ^[0-9]+$ && $manifest == /* && $lock == /* && ! -L $manifest && ! -L $lock ]] || exit 64
canonical=$(realpath -e -- "$root") || exit 64
[[ $root == "$canonical" && $root != / && $manifest != "$root/"* && $lock != "$root/"* && $manifest != "$lock" ]] || exit 64
exec 9>"$lock" || exit 64
flock -n 9 || exit 75
if [[ $mode == preview ]]; then
 tmp="$manifest.tmp.$$"; scan="$manifest.scan.$$"
 (set -o noclobber; : > "$tmp" && : > "$scan") || exit 64
 trap 'rm -f -- "$tmp" "$scan"' EXIT
 find "$root" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.log.gz' -print0 > "$scan" || exit 1
 printf '%s\0%s\0' "$root" "$cutoff" > "$tmp"
 while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
  info=$(stat -c '%d %i %Y %s' -- "$path") || exit 1
  read -r dev ino modified size <<< "$info"
  if (( modified < cutoff )); then printf '%s\0%s\0' "$path" "$info" >> "$tmp"; fi
 done < "$scan"
 mv -f -- "$tmp" "$manifest" || exit 1
 exit 0
fi
[[ -f $manifest && ! -L $manifest ]] || exit 64
exec 8< "$manifest" || exit 64
IFS= read -r -d '' saved_root <&8 || exit 64
IFS= read -r -d '' saved_cutoff <&8 || exit 64
[[ $saved_root == "$root" && $saved_cutoff == "$cutoff" ]] || exit 64
paths=(); infos=(); declare -A seen=()
while IFS= read -r -d '' path <&8; do
 IFS= read -r -d '' info <&8 || exit 64
 relative=${path#"$root/"}
 [[ $path == "$root/"* && $relative != */* && $relative == *.log.gz && -f $path && ! -L $path ]] || exit 64
 [[ ! ${seen["$path"]+present} ]] || exit 64; seen["$path"]=1
 now=$(stat -c '%d %i %Y %s' -- "$path") || exit 1
 [[ $now == "$info" ]] || exit 1
 read -r dev ino modified size <<< "$now"; (( modified < cutoff )) || exit 1
 paths+=("$path");infos+=("$info")
done
[[ -z $path ]] || exit 64
for path in "${paths[@]}"; do rm -- "$path" || exit 1; done
```

原题知识说明：
优先使用已有日志轮转工具管理活动文件；Shell 清理仅作用于明确的归档目录和文件模式。先确认绝对路径、挂载及目标类型，预览命中文件，再对同一范围执行清理；变量引用完整，文件名以空字符边界处理。明确按修改时间还是文件日期保留，find 的整日取整边界要实测。定时任务设置执行身份、PATH、互斥锁和结果日志，验收包含空目录、空格文件名与时间边界。
source: 飞书项目题知识点改编；回答框架不代表用户实际项目经历
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import fcntl,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time
assert os.getuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:preview_validate_and_apply_scoped_archive_cleanup',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-log-clean-') as d:
 base=pathlib.Path(d);root=base/'archives';root.mkdir();nested=root/'nested';nested.mkdir();cutoff=1700000000;manifest=base/'plan.bin';lock=base/'lock'
 names=['old space.log.gz','line\nbreak.log.gz','boundary.log.gz','new.log.gz','active.log','link.log.gz']
 for name in names[:-1]:(root/name).write_bytes(name.encode())
 (nested/'old.log.gz').write_text('nested');outside=base/'outside.log.gz';outside.write_text('protected');(root/'link.log.gz').symlink_to(outside)
 times={'old space.log.gz':cutoff-30,'line\nbreak.log.gz':cutoff-1,'boundary.log.gz':cutoff,'new.log.gz':cutoff+1,'active.log':cutoff-60}
 for name,stamp in times.items():os.utime(root/name,(stamp,stamp))
 def run(mode,basepath=root):return subprocess.run(['bash','task.sh',mode,str(basepath),str(cutoff),str(manifest),str(lock)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 p=run('preview');assert p.returncode==0,(p.returncode,p.stderr)
 fields=manifest.read_bytes().split(b'\0');assert fields[-1]==b'';paths=[os.fsdecode(x) for x in fields[2:-1:2]]
 assert set(paths)=={str(root/'old space.log.gz'),str(root/'line\nbreak.log.gz')},paths
 plan=manifest.read_bytes();manifest.write_bytes(plan+b'junk');assert run('apply').returncode!=0 and all(pathlib.Path(x).exists() for x in paths)
 manifest.write_bytes(plan+fields[2]+b'\0'+fields[3]+b'\0');assert run('apply').returncode!=0 and all(pathlib.Path(x).exists() for x in paths)
 manifest.write_bytes(plan)
 with lock.open('w') as handle:
  fcntl.flock(handle,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB);p=run('apply');assert p.returncode==75 and all(pathlib.Path(x).exists() for x in paths)
 old=root/'line\nbreak.log.gz';old.unlink();old.write_text('replacement');os.utime(old,(cutoff-1,cutoff-1))
 p=run('apply');assert p.returncode!=0 and (root/'old space.log.gz').exists() and old.read_text()=='replacement','changed inode must prevent every deletion'
 assert run('preview').returncode==0;assert run('apply').returncode==0
 assert not old.exists() and not (root/'old space.log.gz').exists()
 for name in ['boundary.log.gz','new.log.gz','active.log','link.log.gz']:assert (root/name).exists()
 assert outside.read_text()=='protected' and (nested/'old.log.gz').exists()
 empty=base/'empty';empty.mkdir();assert run('preview',empty).returncode==0 and run('apply',empty).returncode==0
 print('NATIVE_SHELL_NUL_PREVIEW_INODE_REVALIDATION_LOCK_CUTOFF_AND_PROTECTED_PATHS',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
